description: This is a Java class file implementing a REST controller for managing order-related operations in an e-commerce backend. It provides endpoints for listing user orders, retrieving specific orders, creating new orders from a cart, and updating order status, utilizing Spring Boot, Spring Security, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: OrderController
classes.description: REST controller managing order-related endpoints, including listing, retrieving, creating, and updating orders with security and validation.

methods.name: toOrderItemResponse
methods.description: Converts an OrderItem entity to its response DTO for API output.

methods.name: toOrderResponse
methods.description: Converts an Order entity to its response DTO containing order details and items.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Retrieves all orders for the authenticated user, ordered by creation date.

methods.name: getOrder
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order by ID for the authenticated user.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order from the current user's cart, verifying stock and updating product quantities.

methods.name: updateOrderStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific order; restricted to users with ADMIN role.
